best_idea: A cast that is out of range becomes a walk-to-target state that re-reads the live target and re-checks cost and cooldown each tick, fires only when in reach, and writes the cooldown only at commit.
decision_why: Keep the walk-then-fire loop and gate order, but write cost and cooldown only at server commit and use one range function for start and arrival; the donor does neither and its cooldown is client-side.
acceptance: A server test asserts a cast refused for missing mana or the attack gate leaves the cooldown untouched; a caster outside range walks to the live target and fires once in reach, and still fires when the target moves during the walk.
